findings.highlight: Pure white sunlight shines in through the window
findings.evidenceJa: 外は気持ちのいい快晴らしい
findings.governingReading: outside appears to be pleasantly clear and sunny
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents light entering through a window and omits the inferred fair weather.
mirror moon changes chills into fever and shifts the explicit nighttime anchor to the whole prior day.

findings.evidenceJa: 公園で倒れてからの記憶
findings.governingReading: his memory after collapsing in the park is vague
findings.explanation: The event and place from which Shirou’s memory becomes unreliable disappear.

findings.highlight: Sakura bows to hide her embarrassment
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しのように笑って、桜はぺこりとお辞儀
findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles as though hiding embarrassment, then gives a small bow
findings.explanation: The concealment motive shifts from Sakura’s smile to her bow, and the smallness of the bow disappears.

findings.highlight: going to school early no matter what
findings.evidenceJa: 考えは変わらないようだ
findings.governingReading: her plan to go to school ahead of them appears unchanged
findings.explanation: An unchanged plan becomes defiant determination against opposition.

findings.highlight: to make her go so far
findings.evidenceJa: 誰もが嫌がる道場の雑巾がけを自分に課す
findings.governingReading: she imposes on herself the dojo floor-wiping that everyone hates
findings.explanation: The concrete severity and self-imposed nature of Sakura’s punishment disappear.

findings.highlight: What did she say to Saber
findings.evidenceJa: どんな口上でセイバーにケンカを売った
findings.governingReading: what sort of declaration she used to pick a fight with Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s vivid, limited speculation about the wording of Sakura’s challenge becomes a neutral question.
